<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover" name="viewport"/>
<meta content="dark" name="color-scheme"/>
<meta content="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" name="referrer"/>
<title>WoW Midnight Mythic+ BiS-Dashboard</title>
<meta content="#120d08" name="theme-color"/>
<style>
:root{--bg:#0b0f13;--panel:#151b21;--panel2:#1b232b;--gold:#d4b269;--blue:#4bb4e6;--green:#5bd37f;--red:#d96f6f;--orange:#e7a552;--text:#edf3f5;--muted:#93a3ad;--line:rgba(212,178,105,.23)}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% -15%,rgba(52,91,120,.17),transparent 34rem),linear-gradient(#0b1117,#090c10);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif}.hero{max-width:1500px;margin:auto;padding:34px 24px 28px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:end;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.eyebrow,.section-kicker,.card>span{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:800;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase}h1,h2{font-family:Georgia,serif}h1{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,4.5rem);margin:.25rem 0 .35rem;color:#e8cf92}h2{margin:.25rem 0 .7rem}.hero p{color:#c7d2d8;margin:0}.patch{text-align:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 18px;background:#13191f;min-width:185px}.patch span,.patch small{display:block;color:var(--muted)}.patch strong{display:block;color:#e8cf92;font-size:1.25rem;margin:4px 0}.wrap{max-width:1500px;margin:auto;padding:22px}.notice,.panel,.card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.26)}.notice{padding:12px 15px;margin-bottom:16px;border-left:4px solid var(--blue)}.notice span{color:#b9c7ce;margin-left:8px}.panel{padding:18px;margin-bottom:16px}.panel-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}.profile-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(300px,420px) 1fr;gap:14px;align-items:end}.profile-focus{padding:11px 13px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);background:#11171c;border-radius:6px;color:#c4d0d6}.summary-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}.card{padding:16px;min-height:116px}.card strong{display:block;color:#ead293;margin:10px 0 5px}.card small{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4}.character-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px 1fr 1fr 150px auto auto;gap:9px;align-items:end}label{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}input,select{width:100%;margin-top:5px;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);background:#0c1217;color:var(--text);outline:none}input:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(75,180,230,.08)}.btn{border:1px solid rgba(212,178,105,.34);border-radius:7px;background:#151d24;color:#f1f4f5;padding:10px 12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;white-space:nowrap}.btn:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}.btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(#226991,#174a67);border-color:#5cc2ed}.btn.danger{border-color:rgba(217,111,111,.35);color:#ffc1c1}.favorites-bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(270px,1fr) auto auto auto;gap:9px;align-items:end;margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}.api-message{margin-top:12px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:#0d1318;border-radius:7px;color:var(--muted)}.api-message.ok{border-color:rgba(91,211,127,.3);color:#baf0c9}.api-message.warning{border-color:rgba(231,165,82,.35);color:#ffd49c}.api-message.error{border-color:rgba(217,111,111,.35);color:#ffc0c0}.hidden{display:none!important}.live{color:#9be3af;font-size:.82rem}.character-card{margin-top:12px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:72px 1fr auto;gap:14px;align-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(75,180,230,.2);padding:12px;border-radius:9px;background:#0f171d}.portrait{width:72px;height:72px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold)}.character-name{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#ead293;font-size:1.4rem}.muted{color:var(--muted)}.profile-badge{display:inline-flex;margin-top:5px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(75,180,230,.08);border:1px solid rgba(75,180,230,.2);color:#aee1fa;font-size:.72rem}.character-stats{display:flex;gap:20px;margin-top:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}.character-stats div{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.character-stats span{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}.priority-path{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.priority-chip{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;background:#0d1318;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}.priority-rank{display:grid;place-items:center;width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(212,178,105,.12);color:#e6c77c;font-weight:900}.stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:9px;margin-top:14px}.stat-card{padding:11px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:#0d1318;border-radius:8px}.stat-card strong{float:right;color:#ead293}.stat-card.good{border-color:rgba(91,211,127,.26)}.stat-card.warn{border-color:rgba(231,165,82,.3)}.stat-card.bad{border-color:rgba(217,111,111,.3)}.stat-advice{margin-top:10px;padding:10px 12px;background:#10161b;border-left:3px solid var(--gold)}.blizzard-api-config{margin:0 0 12px;padding:12px;border:1px solid rgba(75,180,230,.22);border-radius:8px;background:#0d151b}.blizzard-api-config summary{cursor:pointer;color:#d7e9f2;font-weight:800}.blizzard-api-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,1fr) minmax(220px,1fr) auto auto;gap:8px;align-items:end;margin-top:10px}.blizzard-api-status-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.stat-source-badge{display:inline-flex;margin-top:5px;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:800;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:#b8c5cc}.stat-source-badge.auto{border-color:rgba(91,211,127,.25);background:rgba(91,211,127,.08);color:#a9efbb}.stat-source-badge.manual{border-color:rgba(231,165,82,.28);background:rgba(231,165,82,.08);color:#ffd19b}.stat-source-badge.fallback{border-color:rgba(75,180,230,.25);background:rgba(75,180,230,.08);color:#a9def6}.manual{margin-top:12px}.manual-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr) auto auto;gap:8px;align-items:end;margin-top:10px}.score{text-align:right}.score strong{display:block;color:#ead293;font-size:1.3rem}.score span{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted)}.progress{height:9px;background:#090d11;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}.progress>div{height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2779a5,#5bd37f)}.summary-pills{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}.pill{padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:#0e1419;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);font-size:.74rem}.table-wrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:8px}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:1100px}th{text-align:left;background:#0c1217;color:var(--gold);font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:10px}td{padding:10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);vertical-align:middle}.bis-equipped td{background:rgba(45,142,73,.22)!important}.bis-equipped td:first-child{box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--green)}.item-name,.current-name{color:#bd9cff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800}.item-name:hover,.current-name:hover{text-decoration:underline}.slot-badge,.source-badge,.status{display:inline-flex;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800}.slot-badge{background:rgba(212,178,105,.08);color:#e3c987;border:1px solid rgba(212,178,105,.17)}.source-badge{background:rgba(75,180,230,.08);color:#a9def6;border:1px solid rgba(75,180,230,.18)}.source-badge.crafted{background:rgba(212,178,105,.09);color:#ead293}.status.match{background:rgba(91,211,127,.11);color:#a9efbb}.status.catalyst{background:rgba(189,156,255,.11);color:#d9c2ff}.status.alternative{background:rgba(231,165,82,.10);color:#ffd19b}.status.missing{background:rgba(217,111,111,.09);color:#ffb8b8}.status.unknown{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:#adb9c0}.small{font-size:.8rem;color:#aebbc2;line-height:1.4}.tier-note{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#c8b0f2;font-size:.76rem}.filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,1fr) 170px 180px auto;gap:9px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:11px}.check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:#c6d0d5}.check input{width:auto;margin:0}.two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}.missing-list{display:grid;gap:7px}.missing-item{padding:9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:7px;background:#0d1318}.consumable-section{margin-bottom:13px}.consumable-section h3{color:#ead293;margin:0 0 7px}.consumable-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:10px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}.gem-list{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}.gem-list span{padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:#0d1318;border:1px solid rgba(75,180,230,.13);font-size:.78rem}.music-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr auto auto;gap:9px;align-items:end}.source-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px}.source-card{padding:11px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:7px;background:#0d1318;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.source-card strong{display:block;color:#ead293;margin-bottom:5px}.source-card span{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}footer{padding:22px;text-align:center;color:#7f8d95;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);font-size:.75rem}footer strong{color:#b8c3c9}@media(max-width:1100px){.blizzard-api-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.summary-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.character-form{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.favorites-bar{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.stat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.manual-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.source-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}@media(max-width:760px){.blizzard-api-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.wrap{padding:12px}.summary-grid,.two-col,.source-grid,.profile-grid,.character-form,.favorites-bar,.filters,.stat-grid,.manual-grid,.music-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.character-card{grid-template-columns:60px 1fr}.character-card>.btn{grid-column:1/-1}.portrait{width:60px;height:60px}}
.bis-update-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap}.personal-bis td{background:rgba(45,142,73,.16)!important}.personal-bis td:first-child{box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 #80dca0}.status.personal{background:rgba(91,211,127,.11);color:#baf0c9;border:1px solid rgba(91,211,127,.18)}.personal-target-note{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#9be3af;font-size:.75rem}.general-target-note{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#8ea0aa;font-size:.72rem}@media(max-width:760px){.bis-update-actions{justify-content:flex-start}}

.buff-config{margin:14px 0 4px;padding:13px;border:1px solid rgba(212,178,105,.18);border-radius:9px;background:#0f151a}.buff-config-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:11px}.buff-config-head strong{color:#ead293}.buff-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:9px}.buff-custom{margin-top:10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);padding-top:9px}.buff-custom summary{cursor:pointer;color:#c9d4da;font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem}.buff-custom-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(120px,1fr)) auto;gap:8px;align-items:end;margin-top:9px}.buff-summary{margin-top:10px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:7px;background:#0b1116;border:1px solid rgba(75,180,230,.13);color:#b9c9d1;font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.45}.buff-summary strong{color:#ead293}.stat-card .buff-delta{display:block;color:#9bd8f1;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}@media(max-width:1100px){.buff-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.buff-custom-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}@media(max-width:760px){.buff-config-head{flex-direction:column}.buff-grid,.buff-custom-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Getrennte Anzeige: Basiswerte und gebuffte Werte */
.stat-display-block{margin-top:14px}
.stat-row-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:16px;margin:0 0 8px;padding:0 2px}
.stat-row-head strong{color:#e7d6a1;font-size:.88rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
.stat-row-head span{color:#8798a1;font-size:.74rem;text-align:right}
.stat-display-buffed{margin-top:10px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.stat-display-buffed .stat-row-head strong{color:#9bd8f1}
.buffed-stat-card{border-color:rgba(75,180,230,.20)!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,31,39,.92),rgba(12,19,24,.95))!important}
.buffed-stat-card .buff-delta{clear:both;padding-top:6px;color:#9bd8f1}
@media(max-width:760px){.stat-row-head{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:3px}.stat-row-head span{text-align:left}}

/* Gemeinsamer Musik-Reiter */
.music-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:4px 0 14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding-bottom:8px}.music-tab{appearance:none;border:1px solid rgba(212,178,105,.22);background:#10171c;color:#b8c4ca;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 14px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}.music-tab:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:#eef3f5}.music-tab.active{background:linear-gradient(#226991,#174a67);border-color:#5cc2ed;color:#fff}.music-pane{animation:musicFade .15s ease-out}.music-service-note{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;padding:10px 12px;background:#0d1318;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:8px}.music-service-note strong{color:#ead293;white-space:nowrap}.music-service-note span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.4}.music-favorites-shared{margin-top:14px}.music-policy-note{margin:12px 0 0;color:#82929b;font-size:.75rem;line-height:1.45}@keyframes musicFade{from{opacity:.55;transform:translateY(2px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}@media(max-width:760px){.music-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.music-service-note{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}}

/* Kompakter sichtbarer YouTube-Player */
.youtube-music-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,1.5fr) minmax(190px,1fr) auto auto auto}.youtube-player-area{margin-top:14px;width:max-content;max-width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid rgba(212,178,105,.18);border-radius:9px;background:#090d11;overflow:auto}.youtube-compact-player{display:block;width:300px;height:300px;min-width:300px;min-height:300px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:#000}.youtube-player-caption{margin-top:7px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem;text-align:center}.youtube-player-area.hidden{display:none!important}@media(max-width:1180px){.youtube-music-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto}}@media(max-width:760px){.youtube-music-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.youtube-player-area{max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto}}


/* Letzte Mythic+-Keys */
.recent-keys-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.recent-keys-wrap{margin-top:10px}.recent-keys-table td{vertical-align:middle}.recent-keys-table tbody tr:hover td{background:rgba(75,180,230,.045)}.key-level{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:42px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:7px;background:rgba(90,169,214,.11);border:1px solid rgba(90,169,214,.20);font-weight:900;color:#bde7fa}.key-result{display:inline-flex;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}.key-result.timed{background:rgba(63,174,94,.12);border:1px solid rgba(91,211,127,.20);color:#b8efc7}.key-result.depleted{background:rgba(212,111,89,.10);border:1px solid rgba(224,122,100,.18);color:#ffc0b1}.key-result.complete{background:rgba(212,178,105,.10);border:1px solid rgba(212,178,105,.18);color:#ead293}.key-link{padding:6px 9px;font-size:.74rem;white-space:nowrap}@media(max-width:760px){.recent-keys-actions{justify-content:flex-start}.recent-keys-wrap{overflow-x:auto}.recent-keys-table{min-width:760px}}

/* Höchster Key pro Dungeon */
.dungeon-progress-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:16px 0 8px;position:relative;z-index:1}.dungeon-progress-head strong{color:#f3f6ff;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.05rem}.dungeon-progress-head span{color:#b8c6da;font-size:.78rem}.dungeon-progress-wrap{margin-bottom:14px}.dungeon-progress-table{min-width:760px}.dungeon-progress-table td{vertical-align:middle}.dungeon-progress-table tbody tr:hover td{background:rgba(126,197,255,.05)}.dungeon-max-key{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:58px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(97,91,191,.24),rgba(43,49,105,.20));border:1px solid rgba(171,184,255,.28);font-weight:900;color:#f1f5ff;font-size:.92rem}.dungeon-progress-note{margin-top:5px;color:#9facbf;font-size:.72rem}.recent-runs-title{margin:14px 0 7px;color:#e5ebff;font-weight:800;font-size:.84rem;letter-spacing:.03em}.dungeon-none{color:#93a3ad}.dungeon-count-pill{display:inline-flex;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(126,197,255,.22);background:rgba(75,180,230,.08);color:#c7e9ff;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:800}
@media(max-width:760px){.dungeon-progress-head{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.dungeon-progress-wrap{overflow-x:auto}.dungeon-progress-table{min-width:650px}}

/* Tafel VII: Mythic+ Dungeon-Bestleistungen */
.mplus-board-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:12px 0 16px;position:relative;z-index:1}.mplus-board-card{padding:14px;border:1px solid rgba(160,176,255,.18);border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(20,27,57,.94),rgba(10,15,31,.96));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04)}.mplus-board-card span{display:block;color:#aeb9d5;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:800}.mplus-board-card strong{display:block;margin-top:7px;color:#f2f6ff;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.35rem}.mplus-ranking-table{min-width:900px}.mplus-rank{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(202,213,255,.28);background:rgba(111,102,210,.18);color:#f5f7ff;font-weight:900}.mplus-score{font-weight:900;color:#dce7ff;font-size:1.02rem}.mplus-success{color:#baf0c9}.mplus-board-note{line-height:1.5}.mplus-board-panel .panel-head{position:relative;z-index:2}@media(max-width:760px){.mplus-board-summary{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mplus-ranking-table{min-width:760px}}.mplus-all-section{position:relative;z-index:1;margin-top:24px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid rgba(169,183,255,.18)}.mplus-all-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}.mplus-all-head h3{margin:3px 0 0;color:#f2f6ff;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.35rem}.mplus-all-table{min-width:900px}.mplus-all-count{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(160,176,255,.22);background:rgba(102,91,188,.13);color:#e9efff;font-weight:800}.mplus-all-table .key-result{white-space:nowrap}@media(max-width:760px){.mplus-all-table{min-width:760px}.mplus-all-head{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}}


/* KeystoneLoot Live-Import */
.bis-import-helper{margin-top:10px;padding:13px;border:1px solid rgba(75,180,230,.20);border-radius:9px;background:#0d1419}.bis-import-helper-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}.bis-import-helper-head strong{color:#ead293}.bis-import-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}.bis-import-text{min-height:92px;resize:vertical;font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.4}.bis-import-helper.hidden{display:none!important}@media(max-width:760px){.bis-import-helper-head{flex-direction:column}.bis-import-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr}}
#keystoneControlPanel .bis-update-actions{position:relative;z-index:2}#keystoneDirectLink,#openBisSource{gap:7px}#keystoneControlPanel .api-message,#keystoneControlPanel .bis-import-helper{position:relative;z-index:2}

/* Standardmäßig ausgeblendete Übersichtsbereiche */
.overview-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 16px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(212,178,105,.13);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(13,19,24,.62)}
.overview-controls .muted{font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.35}
.overview-optional:not(.overview-visible){display:none!important}
.two-col>.overview-optional:not(.overview-visible)+.panel{grid-column:1/-1}
@media(max-width:760px){.overview-controls{align-items:stretch}.overview-controls .btn{width:100%}}


/* BiS-Bezugsquellen */
.bis-acquisition-panel{margin-top:18px}
.bis-acquisition-table th:nth-child(1){width:130px}
.bis-acquisition-table th:nth-child(3){width:38%}
.acquisition-source{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.acquisition-source strong{font-weight:800;color:#e6edf1}
.acquisition-extra{flex-basis:100%;margin-top:3px;color:#9fb0ba;font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.4}
.acquisition-extra b{color:#c7d7df}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .bis-acquisition-table th:nth-child(1){width:auto}
  .bis-acquisition-table th:nth-child(3){width:auto}
}

/* Musik vollständig ohne Popup-Fenster */
.amazon-inline-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,1.5fr) minmax(190px,1fr) auto}.youtube-music-grid-inline{grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,1.5fr) minmax(190px,1fr) auto auto}.amazon-inline-player{margin-top:14px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:center;max-width:720px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(212,178,105,.18);border-radius:9px;background:#0d1318}.amazon-inline-player strong{display:block;color:#ead293;margin-bottom:4px}.amazon-inline-player span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.45}.amazon-inline-icon{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#111b22;border:1px solid rgba(75,180,230,.18);font-size:1.25rem;color:#9bd8f1}@media(max-width:900px){.amazon-inline-grid,.youtube-music-grid-inline{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(max-width:760px){.amazon-inline-grid,.youtube-music-grid-inline{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.youtube-server-helper{margin-top:10px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(214,168,76,.22);border-radius:8px;background:#10161b;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.youtube-server-helper.hidden{display:none}
.youtube-server-helper strong{color:#e7c779;white-space:nowrap}
.youtube-server-helper span{font-size:.82rem;color:#9eb0bb;line-height:1.45}
.youtube-server-helper code{color:#d8e5eb}
@media(max-width:800px){.youtube-server-helper{grid-template-columns:1fr}.youtube-server-helper strong{white-space:normal}}


/* Popup-Musikmodus */
.popup-music-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,1.5fr) minmax(190px,1fr) auto auto}
@media(max-width:900px){.popup-music-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:760px){.popup-music-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}


/* Zielwert-Fortschrittsbalken der Sekundärwerte */
.stat-target-progress{clear:both;margin:9px 0 8px;padding-top:2px}
.stat-target-progress-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:5px;color:#93a3ad;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25}
.stat-target-progress-head span:last-child{text-align:right}
.stat-target-track{position:relative;height:10px;border-radius:999px;background:#080d11;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.48)}
.stat-target-fill{height:100%;border-radius:inherit;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2779a5,#4bb4e6);transition:width .28s ease}
.stat-target-marker{position:absolute;right:0;top:-2px;bottom:-2px;width:2px;background:#ead293;box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(234,210,147,.5)}
.stat-target-progress.missing .stat-target-fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8b642e,#e7a552)}
.stat-target-progress.reached .stat-target-fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2b8a4d,#5bd37f)}
.stat-target-progress.over .stat-target-fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#278b52,#73e09a)}
.stat-target-progress.over .stat-target-progress-head span:last-child{color:#9be3af}
.stat-target-progress.reached .stat-target-progress-head span:last-child{color:#baf0c9}
.stat-target-progress.missing .stat-target-progress-head span:last-child{color:#ffd19b}
@media(max-width:760px){.stat-target-progress-head{flex-direction:column;gap:2px}.stat-target-progress-head span:last-child{text-align:left}}


/* Installierbare App / PWA */
body{padding-left:env(safe-area-inset-left);padding-right:env(safe-area-inset-right);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}
.hero{padding-top:max(34px,calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-top)))}
.hero-app-actions{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.app-install-btn{align-self:stretch;min-height:48px}
.app-mode-badge{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid rgba(91,211,127,.25);background:rgba(91,211,127,.08);color:#baf0c9;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:800}
.app-install-info{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(75,180,230,.24);border-left:4px solid var(--blue);border-radius:9px;background:#0e161c}
.app-install-info>div{display:grid;gap:4px}.app-install-info strong{color:#ead293}.app-install-info span{color:#b8c6ce;font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.45}
@media(display-mode:standalone){.hero{user-select:none}.app-install-btn{display:none!important}}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .hero-app-actions{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start}.hero-app-actions .patch{width:100%}.app-install-btn{width:100%}.app-install-info{align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column}.app-install-info .btn{width:100%}
  h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,11vw,3.2rem)}
  .panel{padding:14px}.panel-head{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}
  .character-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;width:100%}.character-stats div{min-width:0}.character-stats strong{font-size:1rem}
  input,select,.btn{min-height:44px;font-size:16px}
  label{font-size:.8rem}.music-tabs{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top);z-index:4;background:#10161b;padding-top:6px}
  .youtube-compact-player{width:min(300px,calc(100vw - 52px));height:min(300px,calc(100vw - 52px));min-width:0;min-height:0}
}


/* === Midnight-Neubau / Questtafel-Design === */
:root{
  --bg:#070914;
  --bg2:#0b1023;
  --panel:#121731;
  --panel2:#1a2041;
  --panel3:#23295a;
  --gold:#dbe4ff;
  --blue:#7ec5ff;
  --violet:#8b75ff;
  --violet2:#5e47da;
  --silver:#edf4ff;
  --muted:#b5bfd7;
  --text:#f2f6ff;
  --line:rgba(128,140,255,.28);
  --wood1:#241b2c;
  --wood2:#34223a;
  --quest1:#271d2f;
  --quest2:#3c2f59;
  --quest3:#5647a3;
}
body{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(107,88,255,.30), transparent 22rem),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 15%, rgba(66,161,255,.18), transparent 32rem),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #05060e 0%, #090d1b 32%, #070914 100%);
  color:var(--text);
  min-height:100vh;
}
body::before{
  content:"";
  position:fixed; inset:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(118,86,255,.08), transparent 25%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 80% 12%, rgba(71,173,255,.08), transparent 26%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 80%, rgba(160,120,255,.06), transparent 30%);
  z-index:-1;
}
.hero{
  max-width:1560px;
  padding:28px 24px 22px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(125,142,255,.22);
  position:relative;
}
.hero::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
  bottom:-1px; width:min(1100px, calc(100% - 48px)); height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(156,174,255,.55), transparent);
}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(320px,1fr) minmax(340px,680px);align-items:center;gap:28px;}
.hero-copy{padding:18px 0;}
.hero .eyebrow{color:#d9e5ff;letter-spacing:.16em;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(114,114,255,.24);}
.hero h1{margin:.25rem 0 .45rem;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4vw,4rem);line-height:1.03;color:var(--silver);text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(139,117,255,.18);}
.hero p{max-width:760px;color:#d2dcf5;font-size:1.02rem;line-height:1.55;}
.hero-visual{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
.hero-logo{display:block;width:min(100%, 680px);max-height:300px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45)) drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(117,120,255,.24));}
.patch-midnight{min-width:250px;background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20,26,53,.95), rgba(12,16,35,.95));border:1px solid rgba(143,157,255,.35);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.28), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.patch-midnight strong{color:#f5f8ff}
.hero-credits-plaque{
  display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;align-items:center;
  margin-top:16px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;
  border:1px solid rgba(146,162,255,.32);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(24,30,60,.92), rgba(13,18,38,.92));
  color:#dbe5ff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
}
.notice,.panel,.card,.midnight-intro-plaque{
  border:1px solid rgba(128,140,255,.26);
  border-radius:18px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(24,29,61,.98), rgba(12,17,36,.98));
  box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03);
}
.notice{border-left:4px solid #8dc7ff;background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20,26,54,.98), rgba(10,15,31,.98));}
.notice strong{color:#f0f5ff}
.section-kicker,.card>span,.eyebrow{color:#cad8ff}
.panel-head,.profile-focus,.card strong{color:#f2f6ff}
.profile-focus{border-left:4px solid rgba(126,197,255,.9);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.btn{border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#21274c,#141936);border:1px solid rgba(126,197,255,.28);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.btn:hover{border-color:#8dc7ff;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(79,131,255,.18)}
.btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5b73ff,#3146b8);border-color:rgba(180,191,255,.45)}
.btn.danger{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#402234,#27131f)}
#overviewExtrasToggle{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3c2f59,#23182f);border-color:rgba(186,166,255,.35)}
.wrap{max-width:1560px;padding-top:18px}
.quest-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:0 0 16px;}
.quest-tab{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:88px;padding:14px 16px 13px 18px;
  text-align:left;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid rgba(184,193,255,.26);border-radius:18px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(50,35,72,.96), rgba(23,17,34,.98));
  color:#eef3ff;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.24), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05);
}
.quest-tab::before,.quest-tab::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:16px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #fff, #98abff 45%, #4250a8 75%);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(17,17,30,.55);
}
.quest-tab::before{left:14px}.quest-tab::after{right:14px}
.quest-tab strong{display:block;font-size:1.05rem;color:#fff;margin:8px 0 4px;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(118,137,255,.15)}
.quest-tab small{display:block;color:#c8d3ef;line-height:1.35}
.quest-tab-kicker{display:block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#e2e6ff;opacity:.88;padding-left:10px}
.quest-tab.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(101,86,188,.98), rgba(45,34,77,.98));border-color:rgba(204,214,255,.52);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.34),0 0 0 1px rgba(155,167,255,.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.quest-tab.active::selection{background:transparent}
.quest-tab-content.quest-hidden{display:none!important}
.midnight-intro-plaque{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 18px;padding:14px 16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(30,37,73,.98), rgba(14,19,39,.98));}
.midnight-intro-plaque strong{display:block;color:#fff;margin-bottom:3px}
.midnight-intro-plaque span{color:#d2dcf5;line-height:1.45}
.plaque-rune{display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(205,214,255,.35);background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, rgba(165,177,255,.85), rgba(72,84,165,.88));font-size:1.25rem;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(138,118,255,.24)}
.summary-grid .card,.panel{scroll-margin-top:22px}
.card small,.muted,.small, label{color:#c2cbe1}
input,select,textarea{background:#0c1023;border:1px solid rgba(184,194,255,.15);border-radius:12px}
.table-wrap,.music-shell,.stats-table-wrap{border-radius:16px;overflow:auto}
.profile-badge{background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(87,106,255,.24), rgba(60,75,170,.12));border:1px solid rgba(164,178,255,.22)}
footer{max-width:1560px;margin:22px auto 40px;padding:16px 24px;color:#c8d3ef;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid rgba(130,145,255,.18)}
@media (max-width:1200px){
  .quest-tabs{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));}
}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .hero-copy{text-align:center}
  .hero-credits-plaque{justify-content:center}
  .character-form{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .quest-tabs{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));}
  .summary-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .character-form,.favorites-bar{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:520px){
  .quest-tabs,.summary-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero{padding-inline:16px}
  .wrap{padding-inline:16px}
}


/* === Feinschliff: stärkeres WoW-UI / rundes Logo === */
.hero{
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(9,12,25,.92), rgba(8,11,22,.72)),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(110,94,255,.16), transparent 40%);
  border-radius:0 0 28px 28px;
}
.hero h1,
.panel h2,
.notice strong,
.quest-tab strong,
.patch strong{
  letter-spacing:.02em;
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04), 0 0 20px rgba(124,132,255,.18);
}
.hero-logo{
  border-radius:30px;
  padding:10px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(37,33,68,.9), rgba(14,18,37,.95));
  border:1px solid rgba(210,218,255,.22);
  box-shadow:
    0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.38),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08),
    0 0 0 4px rgba(104,85,211,.16);
}
.hero-visual{
  position:relative;
  padding:10px 0;
}
.hero-visual::before,
.hero-visual::after{
  content:"✦";
  position:absolute;
  color:rgba(228,234,255,.58);
  text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(120,134,255,.34);
  font-size:1.4rem;
  top:8px;
}
.hero-visual::before{left:18px}
.hero-visual::after{right:18px}
.quest-tabs{
  margin-top:6px;
}
.quest-tab{
  border-radius:16px 16px 22px 22px;
  border:1px solid rgba(213,219,255,.28);
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(85,71,138,.95) 0%, rgba(48,36,78,.98) 32%, rgba(24,18,35,.99) 100%);
  box-shadow:
    0 14px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.28),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.32);
}
.quest-tab::before,
.quest-tab::after{
  top:auto; bottom:12px;
  width:12px; height:12px;
}
.quest-tab strong{
  font-family:Georgia,serif;
  font-size:1.1rem;
}
.quest-tab small{color:#d7def6}
.quest-tab.active{
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(133,117,214,1) 0%, rgba(71,58,131,.98) 35%, rgba(35,27,57,.99) 100%);
  border-color:rgba(236,240,255,.54);
  box-shadow:
    0 16px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.34),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(180,191,255,.22),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18),
    0 0 26px rgba(113,95,234,.16);
}
.panel,
.notice,
.card,
.midnight-intro-plaque{
  position:relative;
  border-radius:18px;
  border:1px solid rgba(183,194,255,.22);
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(33,38,78,.98) 0%, rgba(15,19,38,.985) 42%, rgba(11,14,29,.99) 100%);
  box-shadow:
    0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.36),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.36);
}
.panel::before,
.notice::before,
.midnight-intro-plaque::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:8px;
  border-radius:12px;
  border:1px solid rgba(110,125,214,.16);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.panel::after,
.notice::after,
.midnight-intro-plaque::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:14px; right:14px; top:0;
  height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(246,249,255,.3), transparent);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.section-kicker,
.card>span,
.quest-tab-kicker{
  color:#e6ebff;
  text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(126,149,255,.12);
}
.profile-focus,
.api-message,
.character-card,
.buff-config,
.table-wrap,
.music-shell,
.stats-table-wrap{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12,16,34,.96), rgba(9,12,25,.98));
  border:1px solid rgba(150,164,255,.18);
  border-radius:14px;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);
}
.profile-focus{border-left:4px solid #8fc8ff}
.btn{
  border-radius:10px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, #3a2f5e, #1e1833);
  border:1px solid rgba(214,219,255,.22);
  box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}
.btn.primary{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, #7d73dd, #45359f);
  border-color:rgba(235,239,255,.34);
}
.btn:hover{
  border-color:rgba(247,249,255,.52);
  box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.24), 0 0 16px rgba(104,89,214,.14);
}
input,select,textarea{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(9,12,24,.98), rgba(16,20,40,.98));
  border:1px solid rgba(186,195,255,.16);
  color:#f5f8ff;
}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{
  border-color:#98cbff;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(104,146,255,.10), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03);
}
.table-wrap table thead th,
.recent-keys-table thead th{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(73,61,128,.96), rgba(42,33,76,.98));
  color:#f3f6ff;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(199,208,255,.18);
}
.table-wrap table tbody td,
.recent-keys-table tbody td{border-color:rgba(160,171,255,.08)}
.overview-controls{
  padding:10px 2px 16px;
}
footer{
  color:#d6def4;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(178,191,255,.18);
}


/* Tafel-Neuordnung: sechs stabile Bereiche */
.quest-tabs{grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));}
#consumablesPanel{min-height:260px;}
#consumablesPanel #consumables{position:relative;z-index:1;}
.source-intro{margin:-2px 0 14px;line-height:1.5;position:relative;z-index:1;}
#sourcesPanel .source-grid{position:relative;z-index:1;}
@media(max-width:1320px){.quest-tabs{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));}}
@media(max-width:760px){.quest-tabs{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));}}
@media(max-width:520px){.quest-tabs{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}


/* === Lesbarkeit / versteckte Datenansicht / Midnight-Wolkenhintergrund === */
html{color-scheme:dark}
select,
select option,
select optgroup{
  color:#f7f9ff!important;
  background-color:#10162f!important;
}
select option:checked{
  color:#ffffff!important;
  background:#3e4b8d!important;
}
select option:disabled{
  color:#7f89a8!important;
  background:#0d1228!important;
}
select:focus{
  color:#ffffff!important;
  background-color:#111831!important;
}

/* Die Zielausrüstung bleibt als Datenquelle im DOM, ist aber nicht mehr sichtbar. */
#gearPanel{
  display:none!important;
}

/* Der bereitgestellte Midnight-Hintergrund wird großflächig und stark weichgezeichnet
   hinter dem gesamten Dashboard weitergeführt. Das eigentliche Logo im Header bleibt unverändert. */
:root{--midnight-art:none}
body{
  position:relative;
  isolation:isolate;
  background:#070914!important;
}
body::before{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  z-index:-3;
  inset:-8vh -6vw;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6,7,18,.18), rgba(6,8,20,.58) 58%, rgba(5,6,14,.86)),
    var(--midnight-art),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 7%, rgba(60,119,255,.42), transparent 30%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 22% 24%, rgba(91,58,202,.38), transparent 31%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 22%, rgba(58,67,187,.34), transparent 29%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#090b22,#070914 72%);
  background-size:cover,cover,cover,cover,cover,cover;
  background-position:center top,center top,center,center,center,center;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  filter:blur(26px) saturate(1.22) contrast(1.03);
  transform:scale(1.08);
  opacity:.72;
  pointer-events:none;
}
body::after{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  z-index:-2;
  inset:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 7%, rgba(119,181,255,.16), transparent 14%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 30% 17%, rgba(161,100,255,.10), transparent 18%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 72% 17%, rgba(96,107,255,.10), transparent 20%),
    repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 8%, transparent 0 58px, rgba(146,137,255,.025) 60px 62px, transparent 64px 92px),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7,8,18,.05), rgba(7,9,20,.58) 68%, rgba(5,6,14,.78));
}
.hero,
.wrap,
footer{position:relative;z-index:0}
.hero{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,10,23,.44),rgba(8,11,25,.28))!important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
}
.panel,.card,.notice,.midnight-intro-plaque{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(28,33,69,.94),rgba(12,16,34,.95))!important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(7px);
}
/* === Ende Midnight-Wolkenhintergrund === */


/* Planungsprofil für Spezialisierungswechsel */
.planning-profile-note{margin:0 0 12px;border-color:rgba(142,197,255,.34);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(31,48,82,.92),rgba(15,24,45,.96));color:#dcecff}
.planning-profile-note strong{color:#fff}


/* Setteil-Sicherung Midnight Saison 2 */
.set-target-note{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#f0dc8f;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:800;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(234,210,120,.18)}
.pill.set-active{border-color:rgba(139,221,163,.38)!important;background:rgba(76,164,101,.18)!important;color:#bff1cb!important}
.set-warning{margin-bottom:9px;border-color:rgba(224,193,100,.3)!important;background:rgba(81,64,27,.28)!important}


/* Blut-DK Zielwertprofil */
.stat-card.exact-over{border-color:rgba(255,190,92,.48)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,190,92,.08)}
.priority-chip .target-mini{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#b9d9ff;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:600}

/* Hero-Talent Schnellwechsel in Tafel IV */
.hero-build-switcher{border-color:rgba(172,151,255,.34)!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(40,34,80,.95),rgba(15,18,38,.96))!important}
.hero-build-buttons{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.hero-build-btn{min-width:180px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(190,202,255,.26);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#302852,#18152b);color:#eef3ff;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.2),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.hero-build-btn:hover{border-color:#9fcfff;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.hero-build-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7569d0,#40348d);border-color:rgba(235,240,255,.55);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.28),0 0 18px rgba(122,111,255,.18)}
.hero-build-btn strong{display:block;font-size:1.02rem;color:#fff}.hero-build-btn small{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#d1dbf4;line-height:1.35}
.hero-build-current{padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(170,188,255,.24);background:rgba(10,14,31,.65);color:#eaf0ff;font-weight:700}
.hero-build-hint{margin-top:0;position:relative;z-index:2}
@media(max-width:620px){.hero-build-btn{width:100%}}


/* Hero-Talent-Ausbau 2026-09-26 */
.status.raidbis{border-color:rgba(91,211,127,.30);background:rgba(91,211,127,.11);color:#a9efbb}
.raid-bis-equipped td{background:rgba(45,142,73,.22)!important}.raid-bis-equipped td:first-child{box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--green)}.raid-bis-target{display:block;color:#baf0c9;font-weight:800}.raid-bis-target a{color:#a9efbb;text-decoration:none}.raid-bis-target a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.raid-bis-pill{border-color:rgba(91,211,127,.30)!important;background:rgba(91,211,127,.11)!important;color:#baf0c9!important}
.hero-build-switcher .hero-build-btn small{display:block;margin-top:3px;opacity:.82}


/* Tafel VII: vollständiger erfasster Saisonverlauf je Dungeon */
.mplus-preference-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:0 0 16px;position:relative;z-index:1}.mplus-preference-card{padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(160,176,255,.20);border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(26,31,67,.96),rgba(11,15,33,.98));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04)}.mplus-preference-card>span{display:block;color:#aeb9d5;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:800}.mplus-preference-card>strong{display:block;margin-top:7px;color:#f5f8ff;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.35rem}.mplus-preference-card>small{display:block;margin-top:5px;color:#c5d1ea;line-height:1.45}.mplus-pref-ranking{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}.mplus-pref-rank-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px minmax(120px,1fr) auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:7px 8px;border:1px solid rgba(160,176,255,.10);border-radius:9px;background:rgba(8,12,27,.55)}.mplus-pref-rank-no{display:grid;place-items:center;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(111,102,210,.20);border:1px solid rgba(202,213,255,.20);font-weight:900;color:#f4f7ff}.mplus-pref-rank-name{min-width:0;font-weight:800;color:#eaf0ff}.mplus-pref-rank-meta{font-size:.74rem;color:#b8c6df;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}.mplus-preference-card.popular{border-color:rgba(91,211,127,.23)}.mplus-preference-card.hated{border-color:rgba(231,165,82,.28)}@media(max-width:760px){.mplus-preference-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mplus-pref-rank-row{grid-template-columns:30px 1fr}.mplus-pref-rank-meta{grid-column:2;text-align:left;white-space:normal}}
.mplus-run-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}.mplus-run-groups{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}.mplus-run-group{border:1px solid rgba(160,176,255,.18);border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,23,49,.96),rgba(9,13,29,.98));overflow:hidden}.mplus-run-group>summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:13px 15px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,1fr) auto auto auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;background:rgba(94,78,174,.10)}.mplus-run-group>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.mplus-run-group>summary:hover{background:rgba(108,91,196,.17)}.mplus-run-group[open]>summary{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(160,176,255,.14);background:rgba(109,92,198,.18)}.mplus-run-group-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-width:0}.mplus-run-group-title strong{color:#f4f7ff;font-size:1rem}.mplus-run-group-title::before{content:'▸';color:#9fcfff;font-size:1.05rem;transition:transform .15s ease}.mplus-run-group[open] .mplus-run-group-title::before{transform:rotate(90deg)}.mplus-run-count,.mplus-run-meta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(160,176,255,.18);background:rgba(9,14,31,.72);color:#dfe8ff;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}.mplus-run-count{border-color:rgba(126,197,255,.28);color:#bfe4ff}.mplus-run-table{min-width:930px}.mplus-run-table td,.mplus-run-table th{white-space:nowrap}.mplus-run-table td:nth-child(2){font-weight:900;color:#eef3ff}.mplus-run-index{color:#9aa8c4;font-size:.78rem}.mplus-run-total-note{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;color:#b9c6de;font-size:.78rem}@media(max-width:850px){.mplus-run-group>summary{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.mplus-run-group-title{grid-column:1/-1}.mplus-run-table{min-width:800px}}@media(max-width:560px){.mplus-run-group>summary{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mplus-run-group-title{grid-column:auto}.mplus-run-count,.mplus-run-meta{justify-self:start}}


/* Beste Mythic+-Basisitems fuer Matrixkatalysator */
.catalyst-basis-panel{border-color:rgba(189,156,255,.34)!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(35,30,70,.96),rgba(13,17,36,.98))!important}
.catalyst-basis-table{min-width:980px}
.catalyst-base-item{display:block;margin-top:7px;padding:8px 10px;border-left:3px solid #bda4ff;border-radius:7px;background:rgba(122,99,214,.10);color:#dfe6ff;font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.45}
.catalyst-base-item strong{color:#fff}
.catalyst-base-item a{color:#cbb8ff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800}.catalyst-base-item a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.catalyst-base-item .base-source{display:block;margin-top:2px;color:#b8c5df}
.catalyst-base-item.pending{border-left-color:#e7a552;background:rgba(231,165,82,.08);color:#ffd49c}
.catalyst-priority{display:inline-flex;margin-top:4px;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(189,156,255,.25);background:rgba(189,156,255,.09);color:#dccdff;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800}
.catalyst-priority.optional{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:#b7c2d7}
.catalyst-arrow{font-size:1.15rem;color:#c9b8ff;font-weight:900;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:760px){.catalyst-basis-table{min-width:820px}}



/* ======================================================================
   EPISCHER WOW-UI-STIL · rein visuelle Theme-Schicht
   Funktionale Selektoren/IDs bleiben unveraendert.
   ====================================================================== */
.wow-epic-ui{
  --bg:#080704;
  --panel:#11100d;
  --panel2:#17140f;
  --gold:#e0ad45;
  --gold-hi:#ffd77c;
  --gold-deep:#7b4b13;
  --bronze:#9a6428;
  --blue:#55a8d9;
  --green:#56d65f;
  --red:#e15d43;
  --orange:#f0a23d;
  --text:#eee7d8;
  --muted:#a9a08f;
  --line:rgba(224,173,69,.34);
  --epic-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.56);
  min-height:100vh;
  color:var(--text);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% -8%,rgba(179,62,18,.18),transparent 36rem),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 2%,rgba(57,97,128,.12),transparent 34rem),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#0c0b08 0,#080704 45%,#050504 100%);
  font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
}
.wow-epic-ui::before{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.48),transparent 18%,transparent 82%,rgba(0,0,0,.50)),
    linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 62%,rgba(0,0,0,.34) 100%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(255,255,255,.012) 0 1px,transparent 1px 8px);
  opacity:.95;
}
.wow-epic-ui::after{
  content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 180px rgba(0,0,0,.78);
}
.wow-epic-ui ::selection{background:#9a6b21;color:#fff5cf}
.wow-epic-ui *{scrollbar-color:#9b6a2b #0b0906}

/* Kopfbereich wie WoW-Fensterleiste */
.wow-epic-ui .hero{
  max-width:1680px;
  margin:12px auto 0;
  padding:20px 26px;
  border:1px solid rgba(232,184,85,.52);
  border-radius:5px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(22,19,13,.97),rgba(8,8,6,.985)),
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 18px,rgba(255,255,255,.015) 18px 19px);
  box-shadow:
    0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.58),
    inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(63,42,18,.85),
    inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(222,164,54,.10),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,225,151,.18);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.wow-epic-ui .hero::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:5px;pointer-events:none;border-radius:2px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,207,103,.20);
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%);
}
.wow-epic-ui .hero::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:1.5%;right:1.5%;bottom:0;height:3px;transform:none;width:auto;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#7f531e 12%,#f0bd55 50%,#7f531e 88%,transparent);
  box-shadow:0 0 13px rgba(231,175,70,.32);
}
.wow-epic-ui .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(440px,1.3fr) minmax(320px,.7fr);gap:24px}
.wow-epic-ui .hero-copy{padding:8px 0 10px}
.wow-epic-ui .hero .eyebrow{
  color:#b89a65;font-size:.69rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-shadow:0 1px 1px #000;
}
.wow-epic-ui .hero h1,
.wow-epic-ui h2,
.wow-epic-ui .character-name,
.wow-epic-ui .mplus-preference-card>strong{
  font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
}
.wow-epic-ui .hero h1{
  margin:.25rem 0 .35rem;
  color:#f5cc69;
  font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.9rem);
  letter-spacing:.015em;
  text-shadow:0 2px 0 #2f1b06,0 0 18px rgba(224,160,44,.18);
}
.wow-epic-ui .hero p{color:#cfc5af;font-size:.96rem}
.wow-epic-ui .hero-logo{
  width:min(100%,480px);max-height:180px;padding:6px;border-radius:4px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(30,24,13,.82),rgba(8,7,5,.92));
  border:1px solid rgba(224,173,69,.42);
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.52),inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(73,45,14,.72);
  filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.55));
}
.wow-epic-ui .hero-visual{padding:2px 0;gap:7px}
.wow-epic-ui .hero-visual::before,.wow-epic-ui .hero-visual::after{content:"";display:none}
.wow-epic-ui .patch-midnight,
.wow-epic-ui .hero-credits-plaque{
  border-radius:3px;
  border:1px solid rgba(218,166,64,.34);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(24,20,13,.95),rgba(10,9,6,.96));
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(75,49,19,.7),0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  color:#c8b993;
}
.wow-epic-ui .patch-midnight strong{color:#f0c761;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(240,187,75,.16)}
.wow-epic-ui .hero-credits-plaque{padding:8px 11px;margin-top:11px;font-size:.76rem}
.wow-epic-ui .hero-credits-plaque strong{color:#f0c761}

/* Hauptbereich */
.wow-epic-ui .wrap{max-width:1680px;padding:14px 16px 30px}

/* WoW-Reiter */
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tabs{
  grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin:0 0 13px;padding:5px;
  border:1px solid rgba(219,169,70,.36);border-radius:4px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#17130d,#090806);
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.42),inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(74,48,17,.75);
}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab{
  min-height:82px;padding:12px 10px 10px 46px;border-radius:2px;
  border:1px solid #3a2d1a;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1c1b17 0,#0f0f0d 54%,#090907 100%);
  color:#d7d1c4;text-align:left;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.035),0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  transition:filter .12s ease,border-color .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease,transform .12s ease;
}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab::before{
  position:absolute;left:13px;top:50%;bottom:auto;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:25px;height:25px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid #8b6427;background:radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%,#f8d87a,#b77b1c 45%,#3a2208 72%);
  color:#201203;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0d0a05,0 0 10px rgba(218,160,47,.15);
  font:700 15px/1 Georgia,serif;
}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab:nth-child(1)::before{content:"⌂"}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab:nth-child(2)::before{content:"♜"}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab:nth-child(3)::before{content:"▥"}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab:nth-child(4)::before{content:"◆"}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab:nth-child(5)::before{content:"✦"}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab:nth-child(6)::before{content:"♫"}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab:nth-child(7)::before{content:"✥"}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:6px;right:6px;top:auto;bottom:4px;width:auto;height:1px;border-radius:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(202,149,51,.30),transparent);box-shadow:none;
}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab-kicker{padding:0;color:#a99772;font-size:.67rem;letter-spacing:.12em}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab strong{margin:5px 0 2px;color:#e8e0cf;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.02rem;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #000}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab small{color:#817d74;font-size:.70rem;line-height:1.25}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab:hover{border-color:#886127;filter:brightness(1.12)}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab.active{
  transform:translateY(-1px);
  border-color:#dda63d;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 22% 36%,rgba(255,169,34,.18),transparent 33%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#6a3d0b 0,#3b2108 52%,#171007 100%);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,205,94,.20),0 0 18px rgba(226,143,25,.26),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,225,139,.20);
}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab.active strong{color:#ffe08a}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab.active small{color:#d9b86c}
.wow-epic-ui .quest-tab.active::before{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #1b0e03,0 0 15px rgba(255,169,33,.55)}

/* Panels und Karten mit graviertem Rahmen */
.wow-epic-ui .panel,
.wow-epic-ui .notice,
.wow-epic-ui .card,
.wow-epic-ui .midnight-intro-plaque,
.wow-epic-ui .mplus-preference-card,
.wow-epic-ui .mplus-run-group{
  position:relative;border-radius:4px;
  border:1px solid rgba(190,133,45,.48);
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(22,21,18,.985),rgba(10,10,9,.992));
  box-shadow:var(--epic-shadow),inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(68,45,18,.66),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,226,164,.06);
}
.wow-epic-ui .panel::before,
.wow-epic-ui .notice::before,
.wow-epic-ui .midnight-intro-plaque::before{
  inset:5px;border-radius:1px;border:1px solid rgba(211,160,59,.13);
}
.wow-epic-ui .panel::after,
.wow-epic-ui .notice::after,
.wow-epic-ui .midnight-intro-plaque::after{
  left:8px;right:8px;top:0;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,215,126,.36),transparent);
}
.wow-epic-ui .panel{padding:18px 18px 19px;margin-bottom:13px}
.wow-epic-ui .panel-head{padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:11px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(178,128,42,.24)}
.wow-epic-ui h2{color:#e9bd58;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #000;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.015em}
.wow-epic-ui .section-kicker,
.wow-epic-ui .card>span,
.wow-epic-ui .eyebrow{color:#aa8c54;text-shadow:none}
.wow-epic-ui .midnight-intro-plaque{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(38,29,15,.97),rgba(14,12,8,.985));
  padding:12px 15px;
}
.wow-epic-ui .midnight-intro-plaque strong{color:#f3ca6a}
.wow-epic-ui .midnight-intro-plaque span{color:#bdb4a2}
.wow-epic-ui .plaque-rune{
  border-color:#b5812c;background:radial-gradient(circle,#f6d26c 0,#9d5e12 46%,#2f1904 78%);color:#271604;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #100b04,0 0 14px rgba(213,143,28,.20);
}
.wow-epic-ui .notice{border-left:4px solid #cf9130;color:#d8cfbc}

/* Formelemente */
.wow-epic-ui input,
.wow-epic-ui select,
.wow-epic-ui textarea{
  border-radius:2px;border:1px solid #544328;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d0e0e,#080807);
  color:#f1ebdd;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.72);
}
.wow-epic-ui input:focus,
.wow-epic-ui select:focus,
.wow-epic-ui textarea:focus{border-color:#c58c30;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(213,151,49,.13),inset 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.wow-epic-ui select,.wow-epic-ui select option,.wow-epic-ui select optgroup{background-color:#0d0d0b!important;color:#f0e8d6!important}
.wow-epic-ui label{color:#a99e88}

/* Buttons im Ingame-Stil */
.wow-epic-ui .btn{
  border-radius:2px;
  border:1px solid #745323;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#25231d,#11100d 52%,#0a0907);
  color:#dfd7c7;text-shadow:0 1px 1px #000;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(218,164,66,.08),0 5px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.30);
}
